data.name: Makkiyah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Makkah', this name means 'resident of Makkah' or 'pilgrim'. In Islamic tradition, making the Hajj pilgrimage to Makkah is a requirement for every able-bodied Muslim once in their lifetime. This name embodies the spiritual journey and commitment to faith that is central to Islam.
